newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana invites bids for tyre and jute sack plants.
newsitem.headline: Ghana invites bids for tyre and jute sack plants.

text.p: Ghana has called international bids for two medium-sized manufacturing companies -- a tyre plant and a factory for jute sacks, an official announcement said.
Located in Ghana's Western Region, Bonsa Tyre Co Ltd (BTCL) is owned 100 percent by the Ghana government and has an installed capacity of 420,000 tyres.
It has been closed since 1990 but was recently refurbished with machinery from Dunlop International Projects Ltd, according to an advertisment in Ghana's Daily Graphic on Thursday.
BTCL contracted a $40.65 million loan from the African Development Bank two years ago for the refit, the government's Disvesture Implementation Committee said in a brochure.
The government wants to reopen the plant before the sale.
Ghana Industrial Holding Corp Fibre Products Company jute sack factory is located in Kumasi, northern Ghana.
The advertisment says it is on "prime industrial estate with extensive grounds for development and the possibility of diversifying into other industries."
